source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.0, data build 963, released 2026-09-30

data.summary: The sample **terrain features** use assembled Battlefields: Armageddon scenery. The **terrain areas** mix **dense** and **light terrain features**. Different **terrain features** affect movement choices and use of **[Hidden](vsdata:core-rule/hidden)**. When placing a **terrain feature**, leave a gap inside the edge of its **terrain area** so models coming from outside can stand beside the scenery. Use pieces of comparable size for substitute **terrain features**. Decide whether each replacement **terrain feature** is **dense** or a **light terrain feature** for its **terrain area**.

detail.placement: gap between feature and area edge accommodates models approaching from outside

substitution.density: identify each feature as dense or light
